about_the_game:
Woofy Run is a fast-paced multiplayer dog parkour game where players race through obstacle courses, set traps, and compete to be the fastest dog in the pack.

Play as one of three unique dog breeds, each with fun animations and distinct abilities. Race through two thrilling parkour maps and invite your friends to join your lobby—or compete with random players in real-time.

Key Features (Demo):

Multiplayer Parkour Racing
Race in real-time with up to 8 players. Invite your friends to your lobby or join a public server for high-speed competitions.

Trap Your Rivals
Use bite, bark, and howl abilities to disrupt your opponents. A well-timed bite can knock back other dogs, giving you the upper hand.

Playable Breeds
Choose from 3 different dog breeds, each with their own personality and animations.

Speed Boosters and Hazards
Hit speed boosters to gain a temporary burst of speed, but watch out for traps and obstacles that can slow you down or knock you out of the race.

Checkpoint System
Don’t worry about falling behind—your progress is saved at checkpoints so you can respawn and stay in the race.

Time Trials
Compete against the clock on two different parkour tracks and aim for the best time.

Lobby Chat & Voice Chat
Chat with friends using the built-in text chat in the lobby or enjoy in-game voice chat during races.

Dog Emojis & Fun Lobby Moments
Express yourself with dog-themed emotes and enjoy playful moments with others before the race begins.

Progression (Demo):
This demo includes 3 playable dog breeds and 2 parkour maps. The full game will feature new tracks, more breeds, and expanded gameplay mechanics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti / AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7500K / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580, 4GB VRam / Intel Arc A380
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Woofy Run is a multiplayer dog racing game where speed, strategy, and sabotage come together. Set traps, avoid obstacles, and race to be one of the top 10 fastest players on every map! Select your favourite dog and join the race!
